headline: King Charles makes surprise mention in latest speech
subheadline: The British monarch tried to turn his recent mishap into a royal joke
author: Web Desk
article_text:
King Charles, known for his witty one-liners in speeches, has tried to turn his recent mishap into a royal joke in front of world leaders.

In his latest cheeky speech during a special dinner for Commonwealth leaders on the penultimate day of their Antigua and Barbuda trip, the 77-year-old couldn't help but take a swipe at British politics back home.

He said with smile: "It has been a great pleasure to meet so many prime ministers, almost as many as I've had at home."

The monarch couldn't resist laughing at his own words once he delivered it, and the guests joined him with a hum of giggles echoing around the room.

King Charles might have been advised by Queen Camilla to cover up that awkward rainy moment with his witty tactics, and he did it. Instead of hiding, he faced it with a smile.

The monarch also changed the mood by addressing his momentary anger that had gone viral.

On Monday when a torrential spell hit the royals at the Sir Vivian Richards cricket stadium Queen Camilla was handed a clear umbrella for shelter, while the King was left standing in the deluge while his team struggled to find an umbrella for him.

After being caught on camera showing his frustration, the monarch lightened the mood with a classic line, joking that he was “growing watercress on my trousers.”

headline: Sindh announces school holiday on November 9 for Iqbal Day
subheadline: State Bank offices to also observe public holiday on Monday, November 9
author: Rana Javaid
article_text:
All public and private educational institutions will remain closed on November 9, on account of Allama Iqbal Day, the Sindh School Education and Literacy Department said.

According to a notification issued on Wednesday, the decision was taken in line with the Steering Committee on Education's meeting held on February 12, 2026.

All public and private educational institutions operating under the administrative control of the department will remain closed on Monday, November 9.

The notification was issued by the Sindh School Education and Literacy Department.

Meanwhile, the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) will also remain closed on Monday, November 9, 2026, according to the central bank.

According to a statement issued by the SBP, all its offices will remain closed on the occasion of the public holiday.

Iqbal Day is observed every year on November 9 to commemorate the birth anniversary of renowned poet, philosopher, and thinker Dr Allama Muhammad Iqbal, who is widely regarded as the spiritual father of Pakistan.

His poetry and philosophical thought played a significant role in inspiring the Pakistan Movement and shaping the vision of a separate homeland for Muslims of the subcontinent.

headline: Kim Kardashian thought one TV role could destroy her career
subheadline: Kim Kardashian shares how Sarah Paulson helped her deal with the negative comments
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Kim Kardashian once thought her acting career might be over after her new show, All's Fair, received harsh comments from viewers and critics.

The reaction was so bad that she even worried the other actresses on the show would face hate because of her.

But things took a turn when people started watching the show just to see what all the criticism was about.

Kardashian said she found it funny that people who wanted to hate the show ended up helping it get more viewers. “I just thought it was so funny that people came in and wanted to hate on it so much that the hate turned into viewers wanting to see how bad it was.”

READ MORE: Kim Kardashian reveals new rule for her next lovestory

The actress, however, also shared how Sarah Paulson helped her deal with the negative comments. Paulson sent her kind voice message and gave her the confidence to continue.

The reality star shared that message changed how she felt about the whole situation.

Paulson also praised her work in the new series, saying Kardashian become more confident and was showing more of her own personality through her character.

READ MORE: Dylan Sprouse exposes how little he earned from Disney hit

Created by Ryan Murphy, the show also stars Glenn Close, Naomi Watts and Teyana Taylor. Although the first series received poor reviews, it became a hit on Disney+.

headline: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle fulfil 'half in, half out' royal dream
subheadline: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex finally achieve their desired goal
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's long-held dream finally came true as they made the most of their 'half in, half out' royal role.

The Duke and Duchess of Sussex returned to the UK in August with an intention to begin a fresh chapter with Archie and Lilibet for an extended period.

The couple performed a series of engagements in Nottingham, a proper royal-style outing to promote charitable work.

READ MORE: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle celebrate 'next chapter' in joint statement

Speaking to New! Magazine, royal commentator Duncan Larcombe shared that Harry and Meghan are exactly doing those things which the Queen asked them not to.

He said, "They have cashed in on their royal status, making tens of millions of pounds by selling out the royal brand – a brand that is usually tightly controlled and carefully orchestrated."

Duncan believes that William has every right to be angry with his estranged brother Harry.

"They are riding roughshod over those rules. You couldn’t ask for a clearer example of 'half-in, half-out,'" the royal expert pointed out.

READ MORE: Meghan's mum Doria Ragland delivers delightful news to Archie, Lilibet

He added, "Some might claim they are just private individuals doing charitable work, but no other private individuals get this level of media coverage."

headline: 'Obsession' director returns with another horror film ‘Mama Bear'
subheadline: Curry Barker is also preparing for bigger projects
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Horror filmmaker Curry Barker is back with a new short film.

This time, the 27-year-old filmmaker brought a strange story about a man who comes face to face with someone who looks just like him.

The film, called Mama Bear, is now available on YouTube and runs for less than five minutes. Its about Floyd, played by Jon Lee Richardson, who gets a phone call from his friend with some worrying news.

His friend tells him that someone looking exactly like him has been seen somewhere. Floyd does not believe him and thinks he is making it up.

READ MORE: 'Obsession' sparks shock reaction with new update after record-breaking run

But the situation gets more frightening when Floyd receives a voice message from his girlfriend, Lacey, played by Katie Sarfie.

She sounds angry as her message makes it seem like someone has done something terrible. Floyd is left to wonder if the person causing trouble is really him or someone who looks just like him.

The short film, moreover, keeps viewers guessing until its final moments.

Barker first became known for his YouTube horror films, including The Chair and Milk & Serial. His film Obsession later brought him wider attention.

READ MORE: Kim Kardashian thought one TV role could destroy her career

He is also preparing for bigger projects. His horror comedy Anything But Ghosts is expected in May 2027 and he will direct a new The Texas Chainsaw Massacre film.

headline: Why is Royal International Air Tattoo relocating to Boscombe Down?
subheadline: Royal International Air Tattoo to relocate to Wiltshire after 40 years at RAF Fairford
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Royal International Air Tattoo (RIAT), the world’s largest military airshow, will move to MOD Boscombe Down in Amesbury, Wiltshire, from 2027 after more than four decades at RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire.

Organisers Royal Air Charitable Trust Enterprises (RAFCTE) announced the decision on Wednesday, November 4, confirming RIAT27 will retain its planned dates of 16-18 July.

The move follows a comprehensive review of the show’s future operating requirements, prompted by increasing uncertainty over RAF Fairford’s availability as the United States Air Force supports operations in the Middle East.

This year’s event was cancelled due to ongoing operations at the base, which saw the arrival of dozens of U.S. bombers.

Chief Executive RAFCTE, Gavin Gager, called it a “defining moment,” adding, “It is about securing the future of the world’s greatest military airshow and the charitable impact it generates for future generations.”

The announcement highlighted the RAF Fairford air base and its surrounding community, emphasizing that the RAFCTE will continue to be headquartered at RAF Fairford.

RIAT is the primary revenue generator of the Royal Air Force Charitable Trust, which contributed over 500,000 STEM-related interactions with young people in the UK during 2025.

The Air Chief Marshal Sir Harv Smyth, who serves as the Chief of the Air Staff, described the move as taking place at "a location with rich aviation history." Councillor Ian Thorn of Wiltshire Council, the council leader, commented: "This is wonderful news for Wiltshire." The event brings economic benefits to local firms through increased visitors.

The RIAT was staged at Boscombe Down airfield in 1990 and 1992. The festival is attended by over 170,000 people, and information regarding participating aircraft will be released shortly.

headline: Ezra Sosa tells Julia Stiles 10 things he hates about her after 'DWTS' exit
subheadline: Julia Stiles, 45, and her pro partner Ezra Sosa, 25, were eliminated from 'Dancing With the Stars'
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ezra Sosa thought of the perfect way to say goodbye to his DWTS partner Julia Stiles.

The pair were eliminated during the Dancing With the Stars Disney Night episode on Tuesday, November 3, after seven weeks. Sosa, 25, paid tribute to Stiles, 45, by writing her a note inspired by her 1999 movie, 10 Things I Hate About You.

In the film’s climax, Stiles’ character Kat Stratford confesses her true feelings for Heath Ledger’s Patrick Verona in a poem she wrote for their English class, listing 10 grievances that ultimately reveal she doesn’t hate him at all.

READ MORE: '10 Things I Hate About You' cast joins Julia Stiles for Heath Ledger tribute on 'DWTS'

Sosa’s version of the poem, which he read aloud to Stiles in an Instagram video, went as follows:

“I hate the way you doubt yourself when I see everything you are / I hate that you can’t see the light that shines from so far / I hate the way you say you’re fine when I know you’re in pain / I hate that when on your hardest days, you’d get back up again / I hate the way you made me laugh, when all I wanted was to cry / I hate the way you trusted me when you were terrified to try / I hate the way you’d hold my hand when things would fall apart / I hate that somewhere in this season, you became a piece of my heart / I hate that people saw the dances but not the battles you fought / I hate that you’ll never understand just how much you’ve taught / But mostly I hate the way I don’t hate you, not even close, not even a little bit, not even at all.”

Stiles held Sosa’s hand throughout the reading, holding back tears. “Oh, my dear! That’s really beautiful, thank you,” she choked.

The pair were eliminated after a score of 33/40 for her paso doble and 36 additional points from the team dance, for a total of 69/80.

Guest judge Cynthia Erivo praised Stiles for showing “real strength” by hiding pain from her rib injury.

article_html:
Ezra Sosa thought of the perfect way to say goodbye to his DWTS partner Julia Stiles.

The pair were eliminated during the Dancing With the Stars Disney Night episode on Tuesday, November 3, after seven weeks. Sosa, 25, paid tribute to Stiles, 45, by writing her a note inspired by her 1999 movie, 10 Things I Hate About You.

In the film’s climax, Stiles’ character Kat Stratford confesses her true feelings for Heath Ledger’s Patrick Verona in a poem she wrote for their English class, listing 10 grievances that ultimately reveal she doesn’t hate him at all.

READ MORE: '10 Things I Hate About You' cast joins Julia Stiles for Heath Ledger tribute on 'DWTS'

Sosa’s version of the poem, which he read aloud to Stiles in an Instagram video, went as follows:

“I hate the way you doubt yourself when I see everything you are / I hate that you can’t see the light that shines from so far / I hate the way you say you’re fine when I know you’re in pain / I hate that when on your hardest days, you’d get back up again / I hate the way you made me laugh, when all I wanted was to cry / I hate the way you trusted me when you were terrified to try / I hate the way you’d hold my hand when things would fall apart / I hate that somewhere in this season, you became a piece of my heart / I hate that people saw the dances but not the battles you fought / I hate that you’ll never understand just how much you’ve taught / But mostly I hate the way I don’t hate you, not even close, not even a little bit, not even at all.”

Stiles held Sosa’s hand throughout the reading, holding back tears. “Oh, my dear! That’s really beautiful, thank you,” she choked.

The pair were eliminated after a score of 33/40 for her paso doble and 36 additional points from the team dance, for a total of 69/80.

Guest judge Cynthia Erivo praised Stiles for showing “real strength” by hiding pain from her rib injury.

headline: Federal cabinet ratifies Pakistan-Kuwait defence cooperation agreement
subheadline: Pakistan and Kuwait signed the Defence Cooperation Agreement on June 11, 2023
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Kuwait had already ratified the pact in July: PMO.
Cabinet okays KP CM-delegated powers to governor.
KP governor to oversee day-to-day provincial affairs.

The federal cabinet on Wednesday ratified the defence cooperation agreement between Pakistan and Kuwait, aimed at promoting collaboration in the defence sectors of the two brotherly countries.

The decision was taken during a federal cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad.

Pakistan and Kuwait signed the Defence Cooperation Agreement on June 11, 2023.

The agreement provides for cooperation in military manufacturing, electronic communications systems, scientific research, military media, and cultural and sports activities.

Under the agreement, a joint military committee will oversee implementation, including the organisation of joint military exercises, official visits and other cooperative programs.

The pact will remain in force for five years and will be automatically renewed unless either side decides to terminate it. It also commits both countries to protecting confidential military information and resolving any disputes arising from the agreement through diplomatic channels.

The agreement was finalised in June 2023, while the Kuwaiti government had already ratified it on July 19.

KP governor to oversee administrative affairs

The federal cabinet also approved the transfer of powers delegated to the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister to the provincial governor for conducting day-to-day affairs during the period of emergency in the province.

The move aims to facilitate the smooth handling of administrative matters and further improve governance in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, according to a press statement.

Under the arrangement, the governor will submit a monthly review report to the federal government regarding the exercise of the transferred powers.

Welcoming the decision, the cabinet expressed hope that the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Advisory Council, under the governor's leadership, would make every effort to ensure the welfare and prosperity of the people and establish peace and security in the province.

New currency designs, Rs10 coin approved

On the recommendation of the Ministry of Finance, the cabinet approved the designs of new currency notes after receiving a detailed briefing on the proposals.

The meeting was informed that artists and designers from across the country had been invited to submit designs, while a cabinet committee established by the prime minister held detailed consultations with relevant stakeholders.

The new notes will feature enhanced security measures to prevent counterfeiting and incorporate modern materials to extend their lifespan.

The cabinet also approved the introduction of a Rs10 coin in place of the existing banknote.

The federal cabinet also ratified decisions taken at the October 26 meeting of the Cabinet Committee on State-Owned Enterprises (CCOSOEs).

It also endorsed decisions taken during meetings of the Cabinet Committee on Legislative Cases (CCLC) held on January 22, February 26, August 5, 18 and 27, and September 11 and 22.

headline: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle choose peace over pressure
subheadline: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry get another beautiful chance to focus on their future life together
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have got another beautiful chance to focus on their future life together in the US, as the Duke has finally dropped his wish for a permanent base in the UK.

The Duke of Sussex's dream of owning a lavish British country estate has hit a financial roadblock, with Harry struggling to secure the money needed to buy the £10 million property he wanted.

Meghan also supported her husband's wish to have a separate property in Britain, but the latest update appears to be even more amazing for the Duchess, as she had no desire in the past to return to the country she had left with several wounds.

READ MOE: Meghan Markle vs Princess Kate: Shocking Palace truth exposed

Now, destiny has chosen peace over pressure. No more running between two worlds. Just one home, one family, and one future built with love in America.

The Duchess has already revealed her desire to spend Christmas with Doria Ragland in Montecito amid reports that the couple may begin the festive season in the UK.

Harry and Meghan are said to have their hearts set on a spectacular Cotswolds home, ideally putting them closer to King Charles and the royal world Harry left behind.

But finding a property they love is one thing; being able to afford it is quite another.

“They have champagne tastes, but the bank balance isn’t matching the ambition,” a source told Rob Shuter.

“They want a magnificent country estate where they can entertain, enjoy privacy and live the lifestyle they imagine for themselves. But a £10 million house is simply beyond their reach right now,” according to the commentator.

The Duke of Sussex's dream of owning a lavish British country estate has hit a financial roadblock, with Harry struggling to secure the money needed to buy the £10 million property he wanted.

Meghan also supported her husband's wish to have a separate property in Britain, but the latest update appears to be even more amazing for the Duchess, as she had no desire in the past to return to the country she had left with several wounds.

READ MOE: Meghan Markle vs Princess Kate: Shocking Palace truth exposed

Now, destiny has chosen peace over pressure. No more running between two worlds. Just one home, one family, and one future built with love in America.

The Duchess has already revealed her desire to spend Christmas with Doria Ragland in Montecito amid reports that the couple may begin the festive season in the UK.

Harry and Meghan are said to have their hearts set on a spectacular Cotswolds home, ideally putting them closer to King Charles and the royal world Harry left behind.

But finding a property they love is one thing; being able to afford it is quite another.

“They have champagne tastes, but the bank balance isn’t matching the ambition,” a source told Rob Shuter.

“They want a magnificent country estate where they can entertain, enjoy privacy and live the lifestyle they imagine for themselves. But a £10 million house is simply beyond their reach right now,” according to the commentator.

headline: Islamabad's One Constitution Avenue to be converted into five-star hotel: Naqvi
subheadline: Interior minister says govt plans to make hotel operational within months
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Cabinet approves JIT report on controversial project.
Naqvi says international hotel chain will be approached.
Affected buyers to receive compensation, assure ministers.

ISLAMABAD: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Wednesday announced that the government would convert the controversial One Constitution Avenue project in Islamabad into a five-star hotel within months, following the federal cabinet’s approval of a joint investigation team’s (JIT) report.

Addressing a press conference in Islamabad, Naqvi said the government would approach a major international hotel chain to operate the building, which was originally approved for a five-star hotel.

“We will make every effort to convert this building into a five-star hotel within the next few months, which was its original purpose,” the interior minister said.

He noted that Islamabad faced a severe shortage of hotels and expressed hope that an agreement with a major hotel chain would be finalised soon.

Naqvi said the federal cabinet had approved the JIT’s findings, paving the way for the government to take legal possession of the property.

He maintained that the Capital Development Authority (CDA) already held possession of the building in official records, but the cabinet’s decision had now provided the necessary legal basis.

The minister said the CDA’s member administration would immediately assume responsibility for managing the building’s affairs, with the government’s priority being to make the hotel operational as soon as possible.

He also assured that individuals entitled to compensation under the JIT’s recommendations would receive their payments.

Naqvi thanked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for supporting the government’s position despite criticism following its earlier move to take possession of the property.

He maintained that the government was determined to apply the law equally, regardless of an individual’s financial or social standing.

'Irregularities'

Speaking at a separate press conference alongside Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Minister of State Talal Chaudhry, Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal said the federal cabinet had approved the JIT report investigating irregularities in the project.

He said the inquiry found that the project had been executed through manipulation of the bidding process, unauthorised relaxation of rules and suspicious documentation.

According to the JIT’s findings, the first auction was cancelled without approval from the CDA Board, while a subsequent auction was conducted under revised terms.

The report also found that restrictions concerning building height, covered area and parking requirements were relaxed without the board’s approval.

Iqbal said the project had originally been approved as a five-star hotel but apartments were subsequently sold in violation of the approved purpose.

The JIT report states that 254 apartments were sold through 99-year sub-leases despite the project’s approval as a hotel with serviced apartments.

The inquiry also found that the lease was awarded to a private company, although the successful bidder was a four-member consortium and the company was not among its members.

It further identified irregularities involving the removal of a bank guarantee requirement shortly before the lease agreement was signed.

The report also raised questions about the authenticity of the project’s documentation, including allegedly forged signatures and irregular registration of the lease.

JIT names alleged mastermind, recommends action

Iqbal said the JIT identified Abdul Hafeez Sheikh as the alleged mastermind behind the irregularities, along with several former CDA officials and other individuals.

The report also named Kamran Lashari, Dr Faisal Awan, Azhar Ali Chaudhry, Brigadier Nusrat Ullah and the late Rai Nawaz Kharal as having acted in collusion.

The planning minister said Sheikh’s company had been blacklisted from future public-sector projects.

He maintained that the irregularities had caused losses to the national exchequer and resulted in individuals being deprived of their money.

Iqbal said the JIT had recommended a fresh, transparent auction of the land and buildings and restoration of the project’s original purpose.

He added that the project should also be renamed because the Ministry of Foreign Affairs had objected to its use of the One Constitution Avenue address, which it maintained belonged to its own premises.

The minister said the government had directed the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) to investigate the roles of those involved, including individuals who allegedly facilitated the irregularities.

He also highlighted recommendations to digitise CDA records and introduce institutional reforms to prevent similar cases.

Buyers to receive compensation

Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said the government would ensure the protection of people who had invested in the project.

He said the JIT had identified serious shortcomings and that NAB would conduct its investigation on merit.

Tarar also confirmed that Abdul Hafeez Sheikh’s name was on the Exit Control List (ECL).

Minister of State Talal Chaudhry said the project had remained controversial for nearly two decades and that action had been taken against it twice during PML-N governments.

He said all concerned individuals had been given opportunities to substantiate their claims, but seven to eight people had failed to appear despite repeated summons.

According to Chaudhry, former prime minister and PTI founder Imran Khan was among those who did not appear.

The minister said NAB would be required to file a reference against those found responsible within three months.

He also assured affected buyers that their principal investments would be refunded along with interest calculated using the Karachi Interbank Offered Rate (KIBOR).

The JIT report recommends that the CDA compensate genuine buyers through refunds of their principal amounts, together with KIBOR-based interest or an inflation adjustment, noting that the authority had collected fees before disclaiming responsibility.

The report further recommends immediate installation of appropriate fire-safety equipment and a comprehensive overhaul of CDA procedures to prevent irregularities in future development projects.

Cabinet approves JIT report on controversial project.

Naqvi says international hotel chain will be approached.

Affected buyers to receive compensation, assure ministers.

ISLAMABAD: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Wednesday announced that the government would convert the controversial One Constitution Avenue project in Islamabad into a five-star hotel within months, following the federal cabinet’s approval of a joint investigation team’s (JIT) report.
Addressing a press conference in Islamabad, Naqvi said the government would approach a major international hotel chain to operate the building, which was originally approved for a five-star hotel.
“We will make every effort to convert this building into a five-star hotel within the next few months, which was its original purpose,” the interior minister said.
He noted that Islamabad faced a severe shortage of hotels and expressed hope that an agreement with a major hotel chain would be finalised soon.
Naqvi said the federal cabinet had approved the JIT’s findings, paving the way for the government to take legal possession of the property.
He maintained that the Capital Development Authority (CDA) already held possession of the building in official records, but the cabinet’s decision had now provided the necessary legal basis.

The minister said the CDA’s member administration would immediately assume responsibility for managing the building’s affairs, with the government’s priority being to make the hotel operational as soon as possible.
He also assured that individuals entitled to compensation under the JIT’s recommendations would receive their payments.
Naqvi thanked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for supporting the government’s position despite criticism following its earlier move to take possession of the property.
He maintained that the government was determined to apply the law equally, regardless of an individual’s financial or social standing.
'Irregularities'

Speaking at a separate press conference alongside Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Minister of State Talal Chaudhry, Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal said the federal cabinet had approved the JIT report investigating irregularities in the project.
He said the inquiry found that the project had been executed through manipulation of the bidding process, unauthorised relaxation of rules and suspicious documentation.
According to the JIT’s findings, the first auction was cancelled without approval from the CDA Board, while a subsequent auction was conducted under revised terms.
The report also found that restrictions concerning building height, covered area and parking requirements were relaxed without the board’s approval.
Iqbal said the project had originally been approved as a five-star hotel but apartments were subsequently sold in violation of the approved purpose.
The JIT report states that 254 apartments were sold through 99-year sub-leases despite the project’s approval as a hotel with serviced apartments.
The inquiry also found that the lease was awarded to a private company, although the successful bidder was a four-member consortium and the company was not among its members.
It further identified irregularities involving the removal of a bank guarantee requirement shortly before the lease agreement was signed.
The report also raised questions about the authenticity of the project’s documentation, including allegedly forged signatures and irregular registration of the lease.
JIT names alleged mastermind, recommends action
Iqbal said the JIT identified Abdul Hafeez Sheikh as the alleged mastermind behind the irregularities, along with several former CDA officials and other individuals.
The report also named Kamran Lashari, Dr Faisal Awan, Azhar Ali Chaudhry, Brigadier Nusrat Ullah and the late Rai Nawaz Kharal as having acted in collusion.
The planning minister said Sheikh’s company had been blacklisted from future public-sector projects.
He maintained that the irregularities had caused losses to the national exchequer and resulted in individuals being deprived of their money.
Iqbal said the JIT had recommended a fresh, transparent auction of the land and buildings and restoration of the project’s original purpose.

He added that the project should also be renamed because the Ministry of Foreign Affairs had objected to its use of the One Constitution Avenue address, which it maintained belonged to its own premises.
The minister said the government had directed the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) to investigate the roles of those involved, including individuals who allegedly facilitated the irregularities.
He also highlighted recommendations to digitise CDA records and introduce institutional reforms to prevent similar cases.
Buyers to receive compensation
Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said the government would ensure the protection of people who had invested in the project.
He said the JIT had identified serious shortcomings and that NAB would conduct its investigation on merit.
Tarar also confirmed that Abdul Hafeez Sheikh’s name was on the Exit Control List (ECL).
Minister of State Talal Chaudhry said the project had remained controversial for nearly two decades and that action had been taken against it twice during PML-N governments.
He said all concerned individuals had been given opportunities to substantiate their claims, but seven to eight people had failed to appear despite repeated summons.
According to Chaudhry, former prime minister and PTI founder Imran Khan was among those who did not appear.
The minister said NAB would be required to file a reference against those found responsible within three months.
He also assured affected buyers that their principal investments would be refunded along with interest calculated using the Karachi Interbank Offered Rate (KIBOR).

The JIT report recommends that the CDA compensate genuine buyers through refunds of their principal amounts, together with KIBOR-based interest or an inflation adjustment, noting that the authority had collected fees before disclaiming responsibility.
The report further recommends immediate installation of appropriate fire-safety equipment and a comprehensive overhaul of CDA procedures to prevent irregularities in future development projects.

headline: 'Celebrity Traitors' star banned from revealing BTS secrets
subheadline: Joanne McNally planned to share some behind the scenes stories from the BBC show
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Joanne McNally has revealed why fans will not get to hear the special episode she recorded about her time on The Celebrity Traitors.

The comedian planned to share some behind the scenes stories from the BBC show on her podcast but the episode was stopped before it could reach listeners.

Joanne recorded the episode with her podcast co-host Vogue Williams. Their producer, Joe Attewell, said the team worked quickly to get everything ready for Sunday.

They, however, finished recording and editing on Friday evening and were excited to share it with fans.

READ MORE: ‘The Traitors' faces unexpected problem despite record breaking ratings

But things changed when the BBC contacted them. Joe said they were told that much of what Joanne discussed broke the rules of the contracts they had signed.

This meant they could not release the recording.

The news came as a disappointment, especially after thousands of listeners sent messages asking about the missing episode.

Vogue said she spent a long time preparing questions because she wanted to hear all about Joanne's experience, also hinting that the interview included some very interesting stories.

READ MORE: 'Obsession' director returns with another horror film ‘Mama Bear'

Joanne joked that they could have landed in serious trouble if they had shared everything.

headline: Mckenna Grace calls out people misquoting her comments about 'nude scenes'
subheadline: The 'Hunger Games' star, 20, recently said she is not agreeing to hypersexual roles 'at this point' in her career
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Mckenna Grace is setting the record straight about her recent declaration that she will not do nude scenes “at this point” in her career.

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping star took to her Instagram Stories on Tuesday, November 3, to clarify her comments, sharing one headline in particular that stated, “McKenna Grace Rejects ‘Nudity or Hypersexual Things’ in Acting Roles Because ‘My Dream Is to Be a Disney Princess Someday.”

“The two quotes being used right now in these titles are unrelated,” Grace, 20 wrote. “I said at this point in my career I think I’m uncomfortable doing something but I respect everyone who does- and I also have a dream job!”

READ MORE: Mckenna Grace reveals one 'terrifying' thing she won't do on screen

The Young Sheldon alum emphasised that her discomfort with nude scenes or hypersexual roles isn’t simply because she wants to be a Disney princess. “It’s just because of my own personal boundaries and the level of comfortability I have with that sort of thing right now at this point in my life!” she explained.

“Silly that it’s become such a source of conversation!” the former child star noted. “So many more important things to talk about.”

In Cosmopolitan’s new cover story published a day earlier on Monday, Grace was asked if there are any roles she’d say no to.

“At this point, I definitely don’t do nudity or very hypersexual things,” she replied. “I respect anybody who can, but it’s terrifying to me. I don’t know if that’ll ever change.”

She noted that although she has taken on less “wholesome” roles before, like her ill-fated character in Scream 7, her ultimate “dream is to try and be a Disney princess someday.”

headline: Piers Morgan drops bombshell on Brooklyn for behaving like Prince Harry
subheadline: Piers Morgan blasts Brooklyn amid ongoing Beckham family feud
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Piers Morgan, who is known for speaking his mind even if it brings love or hate, has once again dropped a new bombshell amid the ongoing Beckham family feud.

When the outspoken TV presenter speaks, the whole world listens, and this time he has said what everyone might be thinking but no one dared to say.

In conversation with Closer, Piers took a brutal dig at David Beckham and Victoria's son, saying: "Brooklyn is a spoiled little brat – he needs to grow up and realise that he owes his family a lot."

The 61-year-old former Good Morning Britain (GMB) host says, "I think it’s disgraceful the way he’s treated them."

READ MORE: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle choose peace over pressure

Morgan did not spare Harry this time and went on: "He’s the Prince Harry of the Beckham world and it’s really outrageous – the fact he carries on, trying to make a living out of being a Beckham."

However, he appears to advise Brooklyn not to follow the Duke's footsteps as he took a swipe on him: "If you feel that strongly about it and you’re really that appalled by your family, change your name."

headline: Hungary exposes 60,000 names of communist-era spy network that monitored friends, families
subheadline: Hungary opens Cold War informer archives in historic move to confront communist past
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Hungary has made thousands of communist-era secret police records publicly accessible for the first time on Wednesday, November 4, allowing citizens to search for people suspected of spying on their friends, neighbours and relatives during decades of authoritarian rule.

Prime Minister Peter Magyar announced that around 60,000 names had been released through an online database, fulfilling a promise that successive governments had failed to deliver since the collapse of communism in 1989.

The records reveal details of a surveillance network used by the country's communist authorities to monitor political opponents, journalists, artists and ordinary citizens.

Informants were recruited through various means, including threats, blackmail and financial rewards. Some were tasked with reporting on their own families and colleagues.

Magyar, who defeated former prime minister Viktor Orban in April's parliamentary elections, warned that the disclosures could reveal painful details about people's relatives, including those who have since died.

He urged Hungarians to approach the information with compassion rather than rush to judge those named in the documents.

The release coincides with the 70th anniversary of the Soviet crackdown on Hungary's 1956 anti-communist uprising.

However, the archives remain incomplete. Officials estimate that around 150,000 people worked as informants during communist rule, but records concerning many of them were destroyed during the 1956 uprising and shortly before the regime collapsed.

Archivists have also cautioned that appearing in the database does not necessarily mean someone actively worked as an informer.

More documents are scheduled for release on February 25, 2027.

Meanwhile, Orban said on Tuesday that communist intelligence officials had attempted to recruit him during his military service, but claimed he refused and was subsequently placed under surveillance.

headline: Marilyn Monroe's unusual eating habits revealed in interview
subheadline: Marilyn Monroe didn’t always have time for lunch
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Marilyn Monroe once shared what she ate in a normal day and her food choices were not what people might expect from one of Hollywood's biggest stars.

In a 1953 interview with Pageant magazine, she spoke about her meals and explained how she managed to eat while keeping up with her busy work life.

Her day started with a rather unusual breakfast. Before taking a shower, Monroe would warm a cup of milk and mix two raw eggs into it.

READ MORE: Sydney Sweeney's Marilyn Monroe connection takes shocking turn

She drank the mixture while getting dressed and also took a multivitamin. The late legend, however, added that this was an easy way to have a filling breakfast when she got to get ready for work quickly.

Monroe didn’t always have time for lunch, so she often saved her appetite for dinner. She usually cooked steak, liver or lamb and ate five raw carrots with her meal.

She loved carrots so much that she once joked, "I must be part rabbit; I never get bored with raw carrots."

READ MORE: 'Celebrity Traitors' star banned from revealing BTS secrets

But her eating routine was not all about meat and vegetables as Monroe also had a sweet side. After her drama classes, she would stop at Wil Wright's ice cream shop and enjoy a hot fudge sundae on her way home.

Along with her food habits, she slept for five to ten hours and exercised for ten minutes every morning using small weights.

headline: Emily Andre reveals how Peter tried to make up for neglected date nights
subheadline: Before marrying Emily, Peter was married to Katie Price, with whom they share two children together, Junior Andre and Princess Andre
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Peter Andre's wife, Emily, has shared an interesting insight into her relationship with her husband, recalling that the couple have not been on a date night for two months.

It is pertinent to mention that the couple tied the knot in 2015. Before marrying Emily, Peter was married to former glamour model Katie Price, with whom they share two children together, Junior Andre and Princess Andre.

Now, in the latest episode of their podcast, At Home With The Andres, Emily revealed how Peter failed to keep up with one important aspect of their relationship.

headline: Google offers employees up to 12 months' salary to quit as AI spending rises
subheadline: Microsoft also offered voluntary buyout to 60,000 of its employees
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Google has extended its voluntary buyout offer to employees in several countries, including Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland. The voluntary exit packages were offered in June this year and it remains unclear if the employees have accepted it.

This comes as the technology giants continue to spend more and more on development of artificial intelligence (AI) and the voluntary buyouts are part of a larger strategy to rein in rising costs.

A Google spokesperson confirmed the news, stating: “In 2025, some of our teams introduced a voluntary exit program with severance. This past summer, in June, we expanded this program globally in a few countries to support important work ahead.”

Last week, the Microsoft also offered voluntary buyout to 60,000 of its employees. Now the search engine company has also expanded its program which was previously offered to employees in the United States (U.S.) and United Kingdom (UK).

In Switzerland, where Google employs around 5,000 people, employees who accepted the packages began leaving in August, according to three people familiar with the matter.

The company offered one month's salary for every year of service, with payments capped at 12 months. At least four employees from one team of around 50 accepted the offer, Reuters reported.

However, employees working at Google's artificial intelligence research unit DeepMind were excluded from the programme.

The company has also kept workers in its cloud computing division outside previous buyout offers as it continues to prioritise investment in AI and cloud technology.

Google previously laid off more than 200 employees in Switzerland in 2023, prompting protests and a walkout by staff.

headline: Nadal lined up to join Perez on Real Madrid board
subheadline: Nadal thanks Florentino Perez and board for inviting him to join Real Madrid's Board of Directors
author: Reuters
article_text:
MADRID: Real Madrid are set to add a champion from another sporting arena to their boardroom, with 22-times tennis Grand Slam winner Rafael Nadal's appointment as a director to be put to members for ratification, the club said on Wednesday.

The board agreed at its November 4 meeting to submit the appointment to the General Assembly of Delegated Members. Nadal is already an honorary member of the club.

"It is a source of immense pride for Real Madrid and for all our supporters that a figure of his sporting and personal stature ... is to join our Board of Directors," Real said in a statement.

The club highlighted Nadal's sporting achievements, including 92 tour singles titles, two Olympic gold medals, five Davis Cup triumphs with Spain and the world number one ranking.

Real said his qualities beyond those honours — including humility, respect for opponents and commitment to charity — also reflected the club's identity.

"All these values form part of Real Madrid's identity, and Rafael Nadal has embodied and championed them throughout his sporting career," the statement said.

Nadal welcomed the invitation.

"I would like to thank President Florentino Perez and the Board for inviting me to join the Board of Directors of Real Madrid," he wrote on social media.

"I have accepted this invitation with great enthusiasm, keen to learn and to contribute as much as I can."

Nadal, who retired from tennis in November 2024, has long been touted as a potential successor to Real president Florentino Perez, although he has played down the prospect.

Perez, 79, secured another four-year term in June after Real's first contested presidential election in two decades.

More than a third of voting members backed challenger Enrique Riquelme, who opposed plans to bring outside investment into the member-owned club.

headline: The 1975 excite fans with tour announcement 'leak'
subheadline: The 1975 reignite tour buzz after Matty Healy dropped cryptic clues
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The 1975 have been on a hiatus for a while, and while Matty Healy caused quite a stir on social media with cryptic clues and hints about what seemed to be their upcoming record, nothing was confirmed.

However, the British band took over the internet when an account "leaked" their tour information.

An X account named Gavin Leigh Davis posted that the Robbers hitmakers will be headed to a UK Tour at the end of 2027, and they could also be the potential headliner of Reading Leeds Festival in August 2027.

The band's fans who were already waiting on their return, quickly flocked to social media and reacted to the rumours.

READ MORE: Matty Healy confirms speculations about The 1975 album, tour amid hiatus

One fan wrote, "oh my god," and "thinking about ross saying in august rumour of them touring next year was news to him," added another.

A third chimed in, "next year will cure all my problems in life," while one inquired, "So new album early 2027???"

More cheered, "we are so unbelievably back," and "OH MY."

While others warned "Stop playing with ma feelings dawgggg are they back for sure for sure, I love this band more then anything," and "don’t even joke."

The band have not officially confirmed or denied the leak.

headline: Zelenskyy awards Melania Trump top Ukrainian honour after ceasefire helps evacuate nearly 800 people
subheadline: The ceasefire marked the longest local pause in fighting since war started in 2022
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has awarded the United States (U.S.) First Lady Melania Trump with the highest Ukrainian state owner, the Order of Princess Olga, for her efforts to secure a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied frontline city of Oleshky.

The presidential decree issued on November 2, 2026, credited Melania with significant personal contribution in humanitarian support of Ukraine. It also acknowledged her leading role in helping the children in the war-torn region.

The Order of Princess Olga, First Class, is conferred upon individuals who have made exceptional contributions ‌in ⁠spheres including science, education, culture and charitable work.

Melania, 56, played a key role in negotiating a six-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the southern city of Oleshky, allowing humanitarian workers to deliver essential supplies and evacuate residents trapped by the fighting.

The ceasefire, which lasted from October 27 to November 1, marked the longest local pause in fighting since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

According to the First Lady, the humanitarian operation enabled the evacuation of nearly 800 people, including elderly residents and children.

Oleshky, located in the Kherson region, has remained under Russian occupation, with thousands of residents displaced since the war began.

Meanwhile, Melania is scheduled to host representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House on Thursday, November 5, to discuss the humanitarian initiative.

Her office said the meeting would focus on the Oleshky ceasefire, with both countries expected to participate

headline: Pakistani-Americans make their mark across US state elections
subheadline: Democrats lead wave of victories as Pakistani-origin candidates secure legislative seats in Pennsylvania, Nevada, Connecticut, Texas and Georgia
author: Sibt-e-Arif
article_text:
Meriam Sabih defeats Republican's Milou Mackenzie.
Maryam Khan wins Connecticut's State Senate District 2.
Hanadi Nadeem wins Nevada Assembly re-election.

Pakistani-Americans have secured a series of victories in US state legislative elections, winning seats across five states and strengthening their representation in American politics.

Democratic candidates recorded victories in Pennsylvania, Nevada, Connecticut, Texas and Georgia. Meriam Sabih and Hanadi Nadeem were among the notable winners, while several Pakistani-origin lawmakers retained their seats. In Florida, however, Republican candidate Imtiaz Mohammad lost his race for the state legislature.

In Pennsylvania, Democrat Meriam Sabih defeated Republican incumbent Milou Mackenzie in the State House District 131 race. According to preliminary election figures, Sabih received 16,374 votes, or 51.1%, against Mackenzie's 15,650 votes, or 48.9%. The result was called with 97% of expected votes counted.

In Nevada, Democratic incumbent Hanadi Nadeem won re-election in Assembly District 34, securing 12,977 votes, or 62.6%. Her Republican challenger, Brandon Davis, received 7,753 votes, or 37.4%. Nadeem, a Pakistani-origin lawmaker born in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and raised in Islamabad, represents a district that includes part of Las Vegas.

Connecticut also saw victories for two Pakistani-origin Democrats. Maryam Khan won State Senate District 2 with 12,855 votes, or 78.9%, against Republican Tim Knotts, who received 3,448 votes. In District 3, incumbent Democrat Saud Anwar retained his seat with 20,543 votes, or 66.5%, defeating Republican challenger Eliott Hughes, who secured 10,350 votes.

In Texas, incumbent Democratic state representatives Suleman Lalani and Salman Bhojani won re-election in House Districts 76 and 92 respectively. Lalani received 44,221 votes, or 66.2%, compared with 22,602 votes for Republican challenger Linda Howell. Bhojani secured 30,501 votes, or 66.9%, defeating Republican JP Woodruff, who received 15,064 votes.

In Georgia, Democrat Farooq Mughal won House District 105, defeating Republican incumbent Sandy Donatucci. Mughal received 15,248 votes, or 60.8%, while Donatucci secured 9,851 votes, or 39.2%. All 10 precincts in the district had reported their results.

In Florida, Republican candidate Imtiaz Mohammad lost the State House District 103 contest to Democratic incumbent Robin Bartleman. Bartleman secured 47,287 votes, or 69.3 %, while Mohammad received 20,917 votes, or 30.7%.

In Pennsylvania's State House District 194, incumbent Democrat Tarik Khan was also declared the winner.

The results were based on preliminary election figures and remained subject to formal certification by the respective state authorities.

headline: Sarah Ferguson's spokesperson shares her only plan with health revelation
subheadline: The former Duchess of York is yet to confirm her plans for Christmas
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Sarah Ferguson, who's said to be going through one of the worst years of her life, is currently focused to improve her health.

The former Duchess of York, popularly known as Fergie, is reportedly renting a six-bedroom property in the Home Counties.

The 66-year-old's spokesperson said: "At the moment she is focused on the now."

She "has no big plans at this stage other than health, family and rebuilding her life in a new home," Fergie's spokesperson told Hello!.

READ MORE: Sarah Ferguson 'revives' career on Instagram as public outings spark fear

Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie's mother is reportedly keeping busy while relocating and quietly sorting through 40 years of boxes.

She is yet to confirm her plans for Christmas as the former Duke and Duchess of York won't be joining the royals' annual gathering this year due to their downfall.

In 2023, the former couple made a surprise appearance at the royal family's Christmas Day celebrations in Sandringham – her first time joining the walk in over 30 years.

However, they did not attend in 2024 or 2025 following growing public scrutiny.

Sarah was pictured in public last week for the first time in six months, alongside her two daughters, Princess Beatrice and Princess Eugenie.

She arrived at St Paul's Church in Knightsbridge to attend a memorial service for her ex-boyfriend, motor racing tycoon Paddy McNally.

Her bold move suggests as she's not the lady who gives into the pressure as she turns a deaf ear to all the speculations about her future.

After facing every storm with a smile, the Duchess of York is showing the world what true resilience looks like. No rush, no noise, just quiet strength and a heart determined to heal.

Sarah Ferguson, who's said to be going through one of the worst years of her life, is currently focused to improve her health.

The former Duchess of York, popularly known as Fergie, is reportedly renting a six-bedroom property in the Home Counties.

The 66-year-old's spokesperson said: "At the moment she is focused on the now."

She "has no big plans at this stage other than health, family and rebuilding her life in a new home," Fergie's spokesperson told Hello!.

READ MORE: Sarah Ferguson 'revives' career on Instagram as public outings spark fear

Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie's mother is reportedly keeping busy while relocating and quietly sorting through 40 years of boxes.

She is yet to confirm her plans for Christmas as the former Duke and Duchess of York won't be joining the royals' annual gathering this year due to their downfall.

In 2023, the former couple made a surprise appearance at the royal family's Christmas Day celebrations in Sandringham – her first time joining the walk in over 30 years.

However, they did not attend in 2024 or 2025 following growing public scrutiny.

Sarah was pictured in public last week for the first time in six months, alongside her two daughters, Princess Beatrice and Princess Eugenie.

She arrived at St Paul's Church in Knightsbridge to attend a memorial service for her ex-boyfriend, motor racing tycoon Paddy McNally.

Her bold move suggests as she's not the lady who gives into the pressure as she turns a deaf ear to all the speculations about her future.

After facing every storm with a smile, the Duchess of York is showing the world what true resilience looks like. No rush, no noise, just quiet strength and a heart determined to heal.

headline: Markets rally as Democrats sweep midterms; Tesla, SpaceX slide on regulatory fears
subheadline: Dow surges 1,500 points as Democratic midterm sweep calms markets
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Markets in America rallied hard on Wednesday following a surprise sweeping victory by Democrats who won control of both the House and Senate. The Dow Jones industrial average gained 1,493 points or 2.88% to 53,280.

The S&P 500 index gained 1.74% to 7,700 while the Nasdaq advanced 1.88%. The Russell 2000 index was up 1.56%, and the VIX index declined by almost 18%, reflecting low investor anxiety.

Crude oil prices fell by 7.5% to $88.86 a barrel after Vice President JD Vance blamed the loss by Republicans on the war in Iran. This also saw the price of gold advance by 3.4% to $4,073 and Bitcoin increased by 3.5% to $80,248. The 10-year Treasury yield declined to 4.90%.

But not all names were in rally mood. Tesla stocks fell 3.35%, and SpaceX fell 3.14% following the anticipated tightening of regulations on Elon Musk's companies now that the new congress is controlled by democrats. Uber also lost ground as ride hailing bookings are lower than expected due to driver shortage problems.

McDonald's stood out by rising 5.32% following its report of improved quarterly profit and revenues, with impressive international results covering for poor domestic sales.

Today's market is indicative of investors' expectations of a new political reality, in which Democratic representatives have already begun to discuss their intentions regarding trade and healthcare policies.

This comes alongside House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries addressing the Democratic victory. In light of declining energy prices and falling volatility, it seems that the clear result of the elections has brought hope for clear policymaking to investors.

headline: Ellen DeGeneres makes donation after friend and producer's death
subheadline: The Ellen DeGeneres Show producer died at the age of 52 on October 30
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The sudden death of Matthew Wright has shocked everyone who knew and worked with him.

The former producer of The Ellen DeGeneres Show died at the age of 52 on October 30 in Los Angeles.

His family has now shared that he died peacefully in his sleep, making the news even harder for those close to him to accept.

Wright's family also shared a heartfelt message about him on a fundraising page set up after his death. They remembered him as a loving person who brought happiness into people's lives and made every moment special.

READ MORE: Ellen DeGeneres to make TV comeback after four years away?

The page, however, has raised more than $94,000, with Ellen DeGeneres giving $5,000 to support the family.

DeGeneres was also left heartbroken by the news. In an emotional video, she broke down while talking about her former colleague, who spent 16 years working on her show.

She remembered how funny and kind he was and said he could always make her laugh.

READ MORE: Marilyn Monroe's unusual eating habits revealed in interview

She also revealed that they were getting ready to work together again on a new project. She spoke about his close friendship with Stephen "tWitch" Boss and said she hoped they were now together, dancing and laughing.

Fellow producer Andy Lassner said he had seen Wright just hours before his death.

headline: Eric Dane 'approved' of daughter's crush on his 'Euphoria' son Jacob Elordi
subheadline: The late 'Grey's Anatomy' star shared daughters Billie, 16, and Georgia, 14, with Rebecca Gayheart
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Eric Dane’s daughter once told him she wanted to marry his Euphoria costar Jacob Elordi.

In his posthumously released memoir, My Book of Days, the late Grey’s Anatomy star revealed that his daughter, Billie, had a crush on the Elvis star, who played Nate Jacobs, the son of Dane’s character Cal Jacobs.

In the memoir, Dane — who died from ALS in February at age 53 — reflects on his changing perspective as he addresses his daughters — Billie, now 16, and Georgia, 14 — whom he shared with Rebecca Gayheart.

READ MORE: Eric Dane admits he and ex-wife Rebecca Gayheart 'aren't a couple...except sometimes'

“I know you’re both starting to get interested in boys. Well, Georgia, you’re starting, and Billie is already there,” he wrote, acknowledging that he had once joked about threatening any boy who came near his daughters.

“When they get older, you want them to be safe,” Dane continued. “But recently, Billie mentioned that she would like to marry Jacob Elordi, who plays my son in Euphoria. I approve. He’s a good kid. See? Maturity.”

Elordi, who is currently dating Kendall Jenner, was also chosen to narrate Dane’s memoir following his death.

Euphoria’s third and final season, which premiered on April 12, marked Dane’s final projects before his death on February 19.

READ MORE: Jacob Elordi slammed as 'angry man' after recent paparazzi outburst

headline: Robert Pattinson details unique experience working in 'Dune: Part Three'
subheadline: Robert Pattinson speaks about joining 'Dune' film with Zendaya, Timothee Chalamet, and more
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Robert Pattinson joined the third instalment of Denis Villeneuve’s Dune, and he has no notes except praises for how the filmmaker works.

The 40-year-old actor spoke about his experience during a new interview and said, “The desert is just another level. There’s this one sequence where I’m in this spaceship, on a gimbal, on the edge of a sand dune, and we had this 350-foot-long model of a sandworm."

The Twilight star continued, "The scale of this stuff is just unbelievable, you’re having your own Dune theme park, where the gimbal is going upside down and flying, and this is not like work at all. There are no negatives. Apart from having your sweat drained out of the top of your head, and getting like bulbous sweat bubbles. But even then, I didn’t even really notice them. He’s so easy to work with, Denis, it’s never really a stress.”

READ MORE: Robert Pattinson shares long-awaited progress update on 'Batman' sequel

Pattinson plays the character of Scytale in the movie, which will be out in theatres on December 18.

Dune will mark the Harry Potter actor's fourth movie of 2026, after The Drama, PRIMETIME, and The Odyssey.

headline: UK plans facial recognition crackdown on illegal immigrants at public places
subheadline: The government says children under 18 will not be included on the watchlists
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The United Kingdom (UK) is all set to launch one of the biggest immigration crackdowns in British history just a few days after changing the settlement rules for legal immigrants.

The British government is planning to deploy live facial recognition (LFR) in transport hubs and public events across the country for general immigration enforcement.

The purpose of deploying LFR is to:

Identify people seeking to re-enter UK unlawfully
Identifying people subject to removal action
Crackdown on broader immigration-related criminality

The move comes after Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood doubled the immigration enforcement budget and increased its workforce by 60%, paving the way for tens of thousands of additional raids, arrests and deportations.

Immigration authorities previously tested facial recognition technology three times at Holyhead port in Wales between November 2025 and February 2026.

However, the latest plans could extend its use beyond ports to railway stations and other busy public places. The Home Office has confirmed that it is considering further trials, although no nationwide deployment date has been announced.

Under the proposed system, cameras would scan faces and compare them against government watchlists. Any potential match would require verification by immigration officers before enforcement action could be taken.

The government says children under 18 will not be included on the watchlists.

However, privacy campaigners have raised concerns over possible misidentification and the use of surveillance technology against people accused of civil immigration violations.

The development follows Mahmood's November 2 announcement of new settlement rules that would increase the standard qualifying period for permanent residency from five to 10 years, with exceptions for certain workers.

headline: King Charles pens emotional personal message as he returns home
subheadline: Queen Camilla and King Charles make an emotional goodbye to the Caribbean
author: Web Desk
article_text:
King Charles and Queen Camilla made an emotional goodbye to the Caribbean on Wednesday as their nine-day tour came to an end with treasured memories.

Taking to the royal family's official Instagram account, the King penned a heartfelt personal message after returning to home.

The monarch wrote: "As my wife and I depart the Caribbean, we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the people of The Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda for the warmth of their welcome and the many kindnesses they have shown us throughout this tour."

The 77-year-old wrote: "After three nations, four speeches, nine days, over 40 different engagements and countless hands shaken in firm friendship, I return home with so many treasured memories…and one slightly damp suit! Charles R"

When the monarch landed in the Caribbean, he addressed the issue, which he branded a "shameful chapter of history," adding: "It fills my heart with horror and my soul with the most profound personal sorrow."

headline: Dave Grohl shares rare insight into marriage after cheating, baby scandal
subheadline: The Foo Fighters star confessed in 2024 that he welcomed a child outside of his marriage with Jordyn Blum
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Jordyn Blum continues to stand by her husband Dave Grohl two years after he admitted to fathering a child outside of their marriage.

Blum was there to support the Foo Fighters frontman as he joined AC/DC on stage at MetLife Stadium for their final Power Up Tour concert on October 2. Grohl stepped in to provide backing vocals when the Pretty Reckless were unable to perform.

Reflecting on the moment on the November 1 episode of The Rock podcast, Grohl, 57, admitted he was “sobbing like a baby” after the performance.

READ MORE: Dave Grohl and Jordyn Woods rework marriage after secret baby confession

“It was so crazy because my wife was on the side of the stage as we played Highway to Hell,” he recalled. “I walked off stage, and I broke down in tears, sobbing like a baby. I was sobbing, like wailing, and I couldn’t believe it. I was like, ‘That is one of the most full-circle moments of my entire life,’ and I will never forget it.’”

The couple, who tied the knot in 2003 and share three daughters together, decided to move forward together despite the former Nirvana drummer’s bombshell confession in September 2024.

“I’ve recently become the father of a new baby daughter, born outside of my marriage,” Grohl wrote in an Instagram statement at the time. “I plan to be a loving and supportive parent to her. I love my wife and my children, and I am doing everything I can to regain their trust and earn their forgiveness.”

View this post on Instagram A post shared by Dave Grohl (@davestruestories)

Five months later, People magazine reported that Blum decided against divorce.

“It was just such a shock for Jordyn. Her first instinct was that she wanted a divorce,” a source told the outlet. “The betrayal felt too heavy. But as weeks passed, she got some space to think and it just felt very sad to her if the family would split up.”

Since then, they have made several public appearances together. Their most recent joint outing was at the 2026 VMAs, where Nirvana reunited to honour Kurt Cobain.

Blum was there to support the Foo Fighters frontman as he joined AC/DC on stage at MetLife Stadium for their final Power Up Tour concert on October 2. Grohl stepped in to provide backing vocals when the Pretty Reckless were unable to perform.

Reflecting on the moment on the November 1 episode of The Rock podcast, Grohl, 57, admitted he was “sobbing like a baby” after the performance.

I was sobbing, like wailing, and I couldn’t believe it. I was like, ‘That is one of the most full-circle moments of my entire life,’ and I will never forget it.’”

The couple, who tied the knot in 2003 and share three daughters together, decided to move forward together despite the former Nirvana drummer’s bombshell confession in September 2024.

“I’ve recently become the father of a new baby daughter, born outside of my marriage,” Grohl wrote in an Instagram statement at the time. “I plan to be a loving and supportive parent to her. I love my wife and my children, and I am doing everything I can to regain their trust and earn their forgiveness.”

Five months later, People magazine reported that Blum decided against divorce.

“It was just such a shock for Jordyn. Her first instinct was that she wanted a divorce,” a source told the outlet. “The betrayal felt too heavy. But as weeks passed, she got some space to think and it just felt very sad to her if the family would split up.”

Since then, they have made several public appearances together. Their most recent joint outing was at the 2026 VMAs, where Nirvana reunited to honour Kurt Cobain.

headline: Top House Democrat Jeffries hails midterm 'American tsunami'
subheadline: "It's important for the president, before we even cross over into the new Congress, to end this war in Iran," says Jeffries
author: AFP
article_text:
WASHINGTON: Prospective speaker of the House Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday hailed the "American tsunami" of Democratic victories in US congressional elections that handed the party control of both chambers of Congress.

"It wasn't simply a blue wave. It was an American tsunami," Jeffries, who is poised to become the first Black person to lead the House when the new Congress convenes in January, told a news conference.

"We're humbled by the outcome," Jeffries said, vowing to "fight hard for every single American, wherever you may reside."

Appearing earlier in the day on "Morning Joe" on the liberal MS Now network, the House minority leader called the result a repudiation of President Donald Trump and his Make America Great Again (MAGA) movement.

However, the Brooklyn Democrat said his party would focus not on retribution but on fulfilling its promise to lower the prices of groceries, gas, housing and health care.

"The American people don't want us to get even," said Jeffries, who succeeded Nancy Pelosi as House minority leader in 2023. "They want us to get things done on their behalf. Because life is way too expensive. We ran on affordability. We won on affordability. And now it's our job to govern on affordability."

Trump has threatened to use his veto power, raising questions about how much Democrats can achieve even with control of both the House and Senate.

Jeffries pointed to the Democratic-sponsored housing affordability bill, passed by large bipartisan majorities in both chambers in July, as something that "should help lay a foundation for the types of things that we can do in the next Congress to actually drive down the high cost of living."

Trump refused to sign the bill, dismissing it as "a yawn" and "so unimportant," but it became law without his signature after the 10-day constitutional window lapsed.

Jeffries also blamed the president's "reckless and costly war of choice in Iran" for driving up fuel and fertiliser costs that fed through to groceries and goods.

"It's important for the president, before we even cross over into the new Congress, to end this war in Iran," he said.

Amid numerous allegations of financial impropriety during Trump's presidency, from his cryptocurrency venture to insider trading, Jeffries warned: "There's a cost to corruption."

"When it comes to the accountability side of the equation, it's going to be our responsibility to follow the facts, apply the law, be guided by the Constitution, let the chips fall where they may, and make sure that wrongdoers are being held accountable."

headline: Ashe marks global milestone with 'Stop The Wedding!' after album release
subheadline: Ashe achieves streaming breakthrough with new single 'Stop The Wedding!'
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ashe has had nothing short of a breakthrough with the release of her fourth studio album, The Girl of Your Dreams, and her first single has now become a global hit.

The 33-year-old musician has been kicking off milestones after milestones with the single, Stop The Wedding!, ever since its release and it is currently ruling the Global Spotify chart at number three.

The Moral of the Story hitmaker took to social media and announced, "My sweet little song, Stop The Wedding!, for the first time ever, is #3 in the world on spotify…"

READ MORE: Ashe earns applause for major milestone after fourth album release

Fans soon flocked together to celebrate, writing, "you're not stopping the wedding till number 1," and "We're getting it all the way to number 1 mother."

A third penned, "after almost 7 years of following your journey seeing you getting the recognition you deserve makes me so extremely happy, I’m so proud of you ."

While others applauded, "#1 BY NEXT WEEK MARK MY WORDS," and another added, "YOU DESERVE THIS SO SO MUCH."

More chimed in, "Have had it on loop since it dropped," and "couldn’t be prouder seriously this growth is insane wowowowow my girl forever," shared one.

headline: Oil prices crash nearly 9% after Democrats sweep US midterms
subheadline: Washington had no immediate plans to launch fresh strikes against Iran
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Global oil prices plunged nearly 9% on Wednesday, November 4, after Democrats seized control of both chambers of the United States Congress, raising hopes that President Donald Trump could face pressure to end the ongoing war with Iran.

Brent crude futures, the international benchmark, fell $9.27, or 8.9%, to $94.29 per barrel by 1658 GMT, hitting their lowest level since September 4.

Meanwhile, US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude dropped $7.44, or 7.8%, to $88.54 per barrel, as traders assessed the implications of the Republican Party's defeat in Tuesday's midterm elections.

The sharp decline came after Trump acknowledged that the war with Iran had contributed to Republican losses, which handed Democrats control of the Senate and House of Representatives.

Investors believe a Democrat-controlled Congress could make it harder for the Trump administration to secure funding for further military operations in the Middle East.

Trump also told the Financial Times on Tuesday that Washington had no immediate plans to launch fresh strikes against Iran.

Dennis Kissler, an analyst at BOK Financial, said the prospect of tighter congressional control over military spending, combined with recovering Middle Eastern oil exports, had increased expectations of a possible peace agreement.

However, diplomatic efforts have yet to produce a breakthrough.

Qatar has stepped up mediation between Washington and Tehran, although a senior Iranian official told Reuters that both countries remain far from reaching an agreement.

The decline also follows a recovery in Middle Eastern oil shipments, easing concerns about disruptions to global energy supplies.

According to shipping data firm Vortexa, exports of crude oil, condensate and refined products from the Gulf averaged 17.1 million barrels per day in October.

The sell-off extended to energy companies, with shares of ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips also falling as investors reassessed the outlook for oil prices.

headline: Hackers target French blood banks in widening fridge cyber campaign
subheadline: Blood products spared as cyberattacks hits French cold storage
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Hackers compromised cold storage units holding blood products at three French blood bank sites, French authorities confirmed Wednesday, November 4.

This marks a dangerous escalation in a wave of cyberattacks on connected refrigeration systems across Europe.

The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said the attack occurred overnight between Sunday and Monday and was not a direct strike, as external providers operating the cold rooms were hit.

Hackers raised temperatures and defrost thresholds to “excessively high levels,” threatening frozen plasma used for transfusions and medicine manufacturing, as well as samples stored for biobanks.

Alarm systems triggered quickly, allowing staff to move blood products to unconnected backup refrigerators. No blood products or samples were lost, and no health impact was identified.

The EFS has alerted France’s national cybersecurity agency (ANSSI) and the health ministry, and has reinforced monitoring of its equipment.

The incident coincided with attacks on supermarket refrigerators in nearly a dozen European countries, including Belgium, Sweden, Finland, Italy, Germany, and the UK, where temperatures soared as high as 50 degrees Celsius, spoiling millions of euros of food.

Hackers recently gained control of the cooling systems at about 700 French supermarkets, resulting in the start of fires and destruction of food items.

The motive behind the attack remains unknown, and there is no group taking responsibility for it. "It's not an isolated event," EU spokesman Thomas Regnier said, urging collective resilience, as Italy conducted emergency intelligence meetings. There is increasing speculation that this might be a form of hybrid warfare, with Western intelligence services believing it is sabotage by Russia after its invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

headline: Xbox unveils playable Series X console encased in five-foot Alligator
subheadline: Microsoft’s new custom Xbox comes swallowed whole by an Alligator
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Xbox has revealed the Series X-BITE, a fully playable Xbox Series X housed inside an anatomically detailed, five-foot alligator replica.

But the catch is that only one lucky fan can win it.

Developed in collaboration with creature animatronics specialists John Nolan Studio, the one-of-a-kind build takes inspiration from Florida’s wildlife and lore.

The studio, known for work on Jurassic World Dominion, The Witcher, and HBO’s upcoming Harry Potter series, used advanced 3D modelling, sculpting, and fabrication to craft realistic scales, ridges, and signature Xbox-green irises with logo-contoured pupils.

Spanning more than five feet from snout to tail, the sculpture integrates operational Series X internals directly into the reptile’s torso, framed by an illuminated Xbox Nexus logo along its spine.

Resting between the predator’s jaws is a custom Xbox Wireless Controller sculpted with deep tooth impressions and textured bite marks.

While the hardware is fully functional and capable of running current titles, Xbox notes the bespoke piece is primarily envisioned as an exhibition centrepiece. The company confirmed no real animals were involved or harmed, and the console is “best as display only.”

The value that Microsoft places on the custom build is approximately $800.

Despite the fact that the announcement from Xbox does not explicitly mention Grand Theft Auto 6, many people interpret this, in combination with "the pure Miami vibes", as a workaround to the situation because Sony has the marketing rights to the game and Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19 in place of Vice City in Florida.

There is only one X-BITE in existence. To enter the contest before November 10 at 11:59 PT, one needs to follow @Xbox on X, Instagram, or TikTok; repost the specified post; and add the hashtag #XbiteSweepstakes. The randomly selected contestant has 48 hours to respond, or "miss the window and this gator makes a clean getaway."
